events.name: Bash
events.head: List product patches and find prices.json
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/; sed -n 1,80p workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -60; find . -name prices.json -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show prices table and patch constants
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; cat app/src/lib/prices.json | head -40; P=workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-frontend-v2/pricing-lineup-2026-10--a3c38d7ce8.patch; wc -l $P; grep -nE '^\+.*(SOCIAL_ACCOUNTS|EXTRA_SOCIAL|TRIAL_DAYS)' $P | head; grep -c '^diff --git' $P

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check patch file lists and key lines
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-frontend-v2; for p in [redacted].patch adi-new-ui--5d6eecf642.patch; do echo "== $p"; grep '^diff --git' $p | awk '{print $3}'; done; echo; grep -nE '^\+.*(9,999|999|ENTERPRISE_BOOKING_URL|cal\.com|Start free trial)' *.patch | cut -c1-200 | head -20; echo; grep -nE '^\+.*(SMS|Telegram|Start Free|add-on|Add-on|Calendly)' [redacted].patch adi-new-ui--5d6eecf642.patch | cut -c1-160 | head
